title: Dogs pay more attention to consonants than vowels when we speak | New Scientist
description: Hooking up dogs to non-invasive EEG monitors has helped identify exactly which component of human speech the animals are most attuned to
author: James Woodford

title: Copying others can help young orangutans build a broad diet | New Scientist
description: Orangutans spend more than eight years learning how to cope on their own, and now we have a clearer idea of how they work out which foods to incorporate into their diet
author: Christa Lesté-Lasserre

title: Backpack massages muscles when it detects they're fatigued | New Scientist
description: A backpack consisting of electrodes, cables and a soft massage head kneads muscles in the back when it picks up on them being fatigued
author: Christa Lesté-Lasserre

title: Taking HRT in perimenopause may ward off cardiovascular disease | New Scientist
description: Hormone replacement therapies may reduce the risk of heart attacks and stroke, but the timing of when they are started could be critical
author: Starre Vartan

title: Skin patch that collects sweat could predict ovulation | New Scientist
description: A patch that measures levels of two reproductive hormones in sweat has shown promise for predicting ovulation in a small study
author: Rachel Melegrito

title: OpenAI agent hacked an Australian government healthcare website | New Scientist
description: There has been a string of incidents reported over the past few months where AI agents have hacked companies. Now, a case involving a government website has been revealed for the first time
author: James Woodford
